body.statement: For the exchange construction in \(\mathrm{def:exchange-certificate}\), \(L_m\le v\le U_m\) at every iteration, \(L_m\uparrow v\), and \(G_m\to0\). Every weak limit point of \(\pi_m\) lies in \(\Pi^{\star}\). Regard each \(\delta_m\) as its \(\lambda^p\)-almost-everywhere equivalence class in \(\mathcal D\subset L^{\infty}(\lambda^p)\); every cluster point in the weak-star topology \(\sigma(L^{\infty}(\lambda^p),L^1(\lambda^p))\) along a subsequence with \(G_m\to0\) lies in \(\mathcal D^{\star}\). These conclusions make no iteration-complexity or convergence-rate claim.
body.justification: The proposition turns the analytic saddle theorem into checkable global upper and lower certificates and places selector convergence in the weak-star compact topology of the unrestricted \(L^{\infty}\) rule space.
body.gap: AradillasFernandezEtAl2025Epsilon certifies mixtures over a fixed finite rule menu; the changed first step here generates Bayes rules and violated endpoint states while preserving the measurable-rule envelope.
body.consumer: The certificate supplies a stopping diagnostic for robust treatment-choice implementations and produces candidate least-favorable priors for analytic study.
